About this Event

A monthly Holosomatic Breathwork in Denver, Colorado
What if you stopped trying to think your way through it and started listening to what your body already knows?
We spend so much of our lives in our heads: thinking, analyzing, overthinking, pushing through and trying to figure out what to do next.
But sometimes, understanding something isn't enough to create change.
Holosomatic Breathwork is an immersive, body-based breathwork experience designed to take you beyond thinking and into the felt experience of your body.
Through intentional breathing, body awareness, music and guided somatic practice, you'll be invited to slow down, turn inward, and explore what may be ready to shift—without needing to force, fix, or figure it all out.

What you might experienceEvery breathwork session is different, and there is nothing you need to achieve or perform.
You may find space to:
Reconnect with your body and your inner experienceBecome more aware of sensations, emotions, and patterns beneath the surfaceRelease tension or emotions you've been carryingExplore a deeper sense of presence and connectionPractice nervous system awareness and regulationMove beyond habitual thinking and into embodied experienceDiscover what becomes possible when you create space to simply feelThis is a small, intimate group experience with a maximum of 14 participants, intentionally designed to feel personal, supportive and grounded.
You don't need to know how to meditate.
You don't need previous breathwork experience.
You don't need to be "good" at breathwork.
And you definitely don't need to have everything figured out.
Just come as you are.
Wildly Regulated is rooted in the belief that your body holds its own innate wisdom.
When we begin to listen—to sensation, breath, emotion, and the signals of the nervous system—we can begin to develop a different relationship with ourselves.
